reviews.title: Do Not Purchase This motherboard.
reviews.comment: This product works for about a month before showing POST issues with VRAM. Within 5 months this board is completely a brick. I do not suggest purchasing this board at all. It is pure junk and ASUS has done nothing to help with the issue. This will be the final ASUS product I build with.
